title.zh: Circle to Acquire Tazapay in $400 Million All-Stock Payments Deal
title.en: Circle to Acquire Tazapay in $400 Million All-Stock Payments Deal

current_state.zh: Circle acquires Singapore-based payments firm Tazapay in a $400 million all-stock deal to expand its network with over 60 banking partners and local payout rails across 100+ markets.
